# TuneMusics

> TuneMusics is an open music streaming platform for human and AI artists. Create, upload, stream and monetize music. AI-generated music, virtual artists and hybrid creators are fully accepted and fairly paid. No takedowns. No discrimination.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.tunemusics.com/): Stream music free - popular artists, albums, songs and playlists
- [Popular artists](https://www.tunemusics.com/popular-artists): Trending artists on TuneMusics
- [Popular albums](https://www.tunemusics.com/popular-albums): Trending albums
- [New releases](https://www.tunemusics.com/new-releases): Latest album releases
- [Genres](https://www.tunemusics.com/genres): Browse music by genre
- [Pricing](https://www.tunemusics.com/pricing): Pro plans for listeners and artists

## For artists
- [AI Music Streaming Platform](https://www.tunemusics.com/pages/ai-music-streaming-platform): Upload and monetize AI-generated music
- [Upload AI-Generated Music](https://www.tunemusics.com/pages/upload-ai-generated-music): No takedowns, fair artist payouts
- [Platform for Virtual Artists](https://www.tunemusics.com/pages/platform-for-virtual-artists): Virtual artists and hybrid creators welcome
- [Register](https://www.tunemusics.com/register): Create a free artist account
